evidence_origin: Downloaded original acquisition archive, every original PDF checked locally, and downloaded dogc_body_recheck.json from successful GitHub Actions run 37276204735. This is a summary, not a byte-identical copy of the original audit.
corrections: The intermediate job-log summary reporting 218 pages and 48 already-verified headers was contradicted by the downloaded archive. The actual files contain 299 pages; its original audit recognized only two document headers. The rejected summary is not used as source evidence.

The old header matcher searched only the first 1200 extracted characters and did not allow whitespace inside printed dates. PDF extraction places many printed mastheads after the body. The corrected matcher requires the full journal/CVE block anywhere in each page's extracted text, and verifies edition, publication date, page number, total pages and same-document CVE across all pages.
The original acquisition audit and original timestamps remain unchanged. The corrected replay is a separate report; it is not a new live acquisition.

A local replay with pypdf 5.9.0 verified all 48 PDF hashes and 299 mastheads but produced whitespace differences on four pages relative to stored text. That diagnostic did not certify exact text replay. The subsequent CI replay uses the repository dependency environment, requires exact text equality and completed with zero text differences.

downloaded_archive_receipts.note: The original ZIP transport metadata discrepancy is retained, not silently waived. Document-level identity, original PDF hashes, pages and provenance agree with the independently downloaded corrected replay. The corrected replay ZIP itself matches its API digest.
